D66053055636E882.title: Application Developer
D66053055636E882.reason: This is a mid-level .NET/C# backend role in a financial services adjacent company.
D66053055636E882.tailoredSummary: A .NET/C# backend engineer with 5+ years of experience, specializing in developing REST APIs and microservices within regulated financial services environments. Proven ability to optimize SQL Server performance and deliver robust solutions using .NET Core and ASP.NET Core, aligning with SWBC's focus on financial technology.
emphasizedBullets: Developed, implemented and tested feature enhancements across .NET Core Web API microservices consuming Azure Service Bus, owning components through the full SDLC under regulated release governance.
Diagnosed an unindexed SQL join in a core stored procedure and redesigned the query logic, cutting execution time from 18 seconds to 1.8 seconds and eliminating recurring incidents for 90+ days.
Reduced nightly aggregation runtime from 40 minutes to under 8 minutes by implementing covering indexes and eliminating table scans.
Designed and developed REST APIs for policy eligibility checks and customer document processing, integrating third-party decisioning engines for automated underwriting workflows.
Developed and maintained unit tests (xUnit, Moq) and enforced quality through SonarQube gates and peer code reviews.
Implemented a RabbitMQ-based caching layer to improve response times for high-traffic customer quote endpoints.
D66053055636E882.coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Application Developer position at SWBC, as advertised. With over five years of experience as a Software Engineer, I have a strong background in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server, with a proven track record of developing REST APIs and microservices within regulated financial services environments. My experience in optimizing database performance, implementing robust testing strategies, and working within Agile teams directly aligns with the requirements of this role.

I am eager to bring my technical skills and dedication to SWBC. I am open to relocating within the EU for this opportunity and will require visa sponsorship. Thank you for considering my application.
